def transform(g):
    import collections
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    tw=[(v[0][3] if False else len(v), v) for k,v in shp.items() if len(v)>1 and min(len(c) for _,c in v)>2]
    if not tw: return [row[:] for row in g]
    size,v=max(tw,key=lambda t:(max(len(c) for _,c in t[1]), t[0]))
    # rightmost member = largest min-column
    src=max(v,key=lambda t:min(b for a,b in t[1]))
    # target: smallest color with exactly one object, excluding src color
    oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    cands=[c for c,n in oc.items() if n==1 and c!=src[0]]
    tgt=min(cands)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a,b in src[1]: out[a][b]=tgt
    return out

def transform2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg)
    oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_:
        if len(cells)>1: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    tw=[v for k,v in shp.items() if len(v)>1]
    if not tw: return [r[:] for r in g]
    v=max(tw,key=lambda v:max(len(c) for _,c in v))
    src=min(v,key=lambda t:oc[t[0]])   # member whose color is rarest
    # target: color with exactly one object, largest object, excluding src color
    singles={}
    for col,cells in os_:
        if oc[col]==1: singles[col]=len(cells)
    cand=[(c,n) for c,n in singles.items() if c!=src[0]]
    tgt=max(cand,key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for a,b in src[1]: out[a][b]=tgt
    return out

def feats(p):
    g,o=p["input"],p["output"]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    tot=collections.Counter()
    for col,cells in os_: tot[col]+=len(cells)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    tw=[v for k,v in shp.items() if len(v)>1]
    v=max(tw,key=lambda v:max(len(c) for _,c in v))
    singles={col:max(len(cl) for c2,cl in os_ if c2==col) for col in oc if oc[col]==1}
    # changed object
    changed=set((rr,c) for rr in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[rr][c]!=o[rr][c])
    src=[(col,cells) for col,cells in os_ if len(cells)==len(changed) and all(t in changed for t in cells)][0]
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda c:singles[c]); tcells=[cl for c2,cl in os_ if c2==tgt][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[]
    for col,cells in v:
        m=min(r for r,_ in cells)
        npairs=sum(1 for vv in tw for c2,_ in vv if c2==col)
        adj=any(col!=c2 and col!=bg and mindist(cells,cl)==1 for c2,cl in os_ if c2!=col)
        out.append(dict(col=col,oc=oc[col],tot=tot[col],size=len(cells),row=m,colc=min(c for _,c in cells),
            dtarget=mindist(cells,tcells),npairs=npairs,adj=adj,fill=len(cells)/((max(r for r,_ in cells)-m+1)*(max(c for _,c in cells)-min(c for _,c in cells)+1))))
    return dict(src=src[0][0],tgt=tgt,members=out,h=h,w=w,bg=bg)
T=[feats(p) for p in pairs]
for i,x in enumerate(T):
    print(i,"src",x["src"],"tgt",x["tgt"],"bg",x["bg"],x["h"],"x",x["w"])
    for m in x["members"]: print("   ",m)

def analyze(p, ver=1):
    g,o=p["input"],p["output"]
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    tw=[v for k,v in shp.items() if len(set(c for c,_ in v))>1]   # cross-color shape duplicates
    changed=set((rr,c) for rr in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[rr][c]!=o[rr][c])
    src=tuple([ (col,cells) for col,cells in os_ if len(cells)==len(changed) and all(t in changed for t in cells)][0])

    # pairs sorted by size desc; find pair containing src

    pair=[v for v in tw_sorted if any(c==src[0] and cells==src[1] for c,cells in v)][0]
    info=[]
    for col,cells in pair:

import itertools
def groups_info(d):
    # rebuild group structures from D entry
    g,o=pairs[D.index(d)]["input"],pairs[D.index(d)]["output"]
    return d
# Recompute rich structures per demo
S=[]
for p in pairs:
    g,o=p["input"],p["output"]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    tot=collections.Counter()
    for col,cells in os_: tot[col]+=len(cells)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    changed=set((rr,c) for rr in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[rr][c]!=o[rr][c])
    src=[ (col,cells) for col,cells in os_ if len(cells)==len(changed) and all(t in changed for t in cells)][0]
    S.append(dict(g=g,o=o,h=h,w=w,bg=bg,os_=os_,oc=oc,tot=tot,shp=shp,grps=grps,src=src))
def gfeat(grp,d):
    sizes=[len(c) for _,c in grp]
    return dict(maxsize=max(sizes),minsize=min(sizes),sum=sum(sizes),
        maxtot=max(d["tot"][c] for c,_ in grp),mintot=min(d["tot"][c] for c,_ in grp),
        maxoc=max(d["oc"][c] for c,_ in grp),minoc=min(d["oc"][c] for c,_ in grp),
        dupcol=len(set(c for c,_ in grp)),n=len(grp))
def mfeat(col,cells,d):
    h,w=d["h"],d["w"]
    bt=sum(1 for r,c in cells if r in(0,h-1) or c in(0,w-1))
    singles={c:max(len(cl) for c2,cl in d["os_"] if c2==c) for c in d["oc"] if d["oc"][c]==1 and c!=col}
    bigc=[cl for c2,cl in d["os_"] if c2==max(singles,key=lambda c:singles[c])][0] if singles else None
    part=[cl for c2,cl in d["shp"][norm(cells)] if cl!=cells]
    return dict(oc=d["oc"][col],tot=d["tot"][col],size=len(cells),row=min(r for r,_ in cells),col=min(c for _,c in cells),
        bt=bt,dbig=mindist(cells,bigc) if bigc else 999,
        dpart=min(mindist(cells,pc) for pc in part) if part else 999, fill=len(cells)/((max(r for r,_ in cells)-min(r for r,_ in cells)+1)*(max(c for _,c in cells)-min(c for _,c in cells)+1)))
gkeys=list(gfeat(S[0]["grps"][0],S[0]).keys())
mkeys=list(mfeat(5,[(2,5)],S[0]).keys())
sol=[]
for gk in gkeys:
    for gext in ('max','min'):
        for mk in mkeys:
            for mext in ('max','min'):
                ok=True
                for d in S:
                    grps=d["grps"]
                    sel=max(grps,key=lambda gp:(gfeat(gp,d)[gk] if gext=='max' else -gfeat(gp,d)[gk]))
                    if not any(c==d["src"][0] and cells==d["src"][1] for c,cells in sel): ok=False;break
                    mem=sel[0] if sel[0][1]==d["src"][1] else sel[1]
                    f=mfeat(*mem,d)[mk]
                    fsrc=mfeat(*d["src"],d)[mk]
                    if (mext=='max' and f!=max(mfeat(*m,d)[mk] for m in sel)) or (mext=='min' and f!=min(mfeat(*m,d)[mk] for m in sel)): ok=False;break
                if ok: sol.append((gk,gext,mk,mext))

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    tot=collections.Counter()
    for col,cells in os_: tot[col]+=len(cells)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    if not grps: return [r[:] for r in g]
    sel=max(grps,key=lambda gp:min(tot[c] for c,_ in gp))
    src=max(sel,key=lambda t:min(c for _,c in t[1]))
    singles={c:max(len(cl) for c2,cl in os_ if c2==c) for c in oc if oc[c]==1 and c!=src[0]}
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda c:singles[c])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for a,b in src[1]: out[a][b]=tgt
    return out
for i,p in enumerate(pairs):
    print(i, transform3(p["input"])==p["output"])

    bigc=[cl for c2,cl in d["os_"] if c2==max(d["singles"],key=lambda c:d["singles"][c])][0]

        h,w=d["h"],d["w"]

            fill=round(len(cells)/((max(r for r,_ in cells)-min(r for r,_ in cells)+1)*(max(c for _,c in cells)-min(c for _,c in cells)+1)),2),
            dupcol=len(set(c for c,_ in d["shp"][norm(cells)])))
    return F

def transform4(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    tot=collections.Counter()
    for col,cells in os_: tot[col]+=len(cells)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    sel=max(grps,key=lambda gp:max(len(c) for _,c in gp))
    # member: farthest from largest singleton (tie -> larger tot)
    def big():
        cand=[cl for c2,cl in os_ if oc[c2]==1]
        return max(cand,key=len) if cand else None
    B=big()
    def db(m): return mindist(m[1],B)
    src=max(sel,key=lambda m:(db(m),tot[m[0]]))
    singles={c:max(len(cl) for c2,cl in os_ if c2==c) for c in oc if oc[c]==1 and c!=src[0]}
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda c:singles[c])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for a,b in src[1]: out[a][b]=tgt
    return out, src[0], tgt

def transform6(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg); oc=collections.Counter(col for col,_ in os_)
    tot=collections.Counter()
    for col,cells in os_: tot[col]+=len(cells)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[norm(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    dupcols=set(c for gp in grps for c,_ in gp)
    sel=max(grps,key=lambda gp:max(len(c) for _,c in gp))
    cand=[cl for c2,cl in os_ if oc[c2]==1 and c2 not in dupcols]
    B=max(cand,key=len)
    src=max(sel,key=lambda m:(mindist(m[1],B),min(r for r,_ in m[1])))
    tgt=max((c for c in oc if oc[c]==1 and c not in dupcols and c!=src[0]),key=lambda c:max(len(cl) for c2,cl in os_ if c2==c))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for a,b in src[1]: out[a][b]=tgt
    return out,src[0],tgt

def feats_demo(di, do, verbose=False):
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in di for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(di,bg)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[key(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    changed=[(r_,c_,di[r_][c_],do[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(len(di)) for c_ in range(len(di[0])) if di[r_][c_]!=do[r_][c_]]
    scol, tcol = changed[0][2], changed[0][3]
    src_cells=[cl for c,cl in os_ if c==scol and (changed[0][0],changed[0][1]) in cl][0]
    tgt_cells=[cl for c,cl in os_ if c==tcol][0]
    # find source group
    sg=[gp for gp in grps if any(cl==src_cells for _,cl in gp)][0]
    pure = len(set(c for c,_ in sg))==1
    # target candidates: singleton colors unique shape
    occ=collections.Counter(c for c,_ in os_)
    dupcols=set(c for gp in grps for c,_ in gp)
    cands=[]
    for c_ in occ:
        objs=[cl for cc,cl in os_ if cc==c_]
        shapes=[key(cl) for cl in objs]
        if len(objs)==1 and shapes[0] not in shp or len(objs)==1 and all(len(gp)==1 or key(gp[0][1])!=shapes[0] for gp in grps):
            cands.append((c_,len(objs[0])))
    # simpler: singleton objects whose shape group has only them
    cands=[]
    for c_,cl in os_:
        if occ[c_]>1: continue
        if len(shp[key(cl)])==1: cands.append((c_,len(cl)))
    B = max([cl for c_,sz in cands], key=len) if cands else None
    tc = [c_ for c_,cl in os_ if cl==B][0]
    res=[]
    for c_,cl in sg:
        dmin=mindist(cl,B)
        top=min(r for r,_ in cl); left=min(c for _,c in cl); right=max(c for _,c in cl); bot=max(r for r,_ in cl)
        res.append((c_,len(cl),dmin,top,left,right,bot,cl==src_cells))
    return dict(pure=pure, target=tc, tgtsize=len(B), src=scol, group=[(c_,len(cl),mindist(cl,B),min(r for r,_ in cl),min(c for _,c in cl)) for c_,cl in sg], chosen=src_cells)

for i,pr in enumerate(pairs):
    f=feats_demo(pr['input'],pr['output'])
    print('demo',i,'pure',f['pure'],'tgt',f['target'],'src',f['src'],'chosenrow',min(r for r,_ in f['chosen']),'group:',f['group'])

def transform_final(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    os_=obj_cells(g,bg)
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[key(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    occ=collections.Counter(c for c,_ in os_)
    dupcols=set(c for gp in grps for c,_ in gp)
    # target: singleton color, unique shape, largest object
    tcands=[]
    for c_ in occ:
        if occ[c_]!=1 or c_ in dupcols: continue
        cl=[x for cc,x in os_ if cc==c_][0]
        if len(shp[key(cl)])==1: tcands.append((c_,len(cl)))
    tcol=max(tcands,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    T=[cl for c2,cl in os_ if c2==tcol][0]
    # group: pure same-color groups first (largest), else largest group
    pures=[gp for gp in grps if len(set(c for c,_ in gp))==1]
    pool = pures if pures else grps
    sel=max(pool,key=lambda gp:max(len(cl) for _,cl in gp))
    # member: farthest from target, tie -> larger top row
    m=max(sel,key=lambda m:(mindist(m[1],T),max(r for r,_ in m[1])))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a,b in m[1]: out[a][b]=tcol
    return out,tcol,m[0]

src_code = '''
import collections

def _key(cells):
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    return tuple(sorted((r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in cells))

def _mindist(a,b):
    return min(abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2) for r1,c1 in a for r2,c2 in b)

def transform(grid):
    g=grid
    cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # connected objects (4-conn) of non-bg colors
    seen=set(); os_=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]) and (na,nb) not in seen and g[na][nb]==col:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); stack.append((na,nb))
                os_.append((col,cells))
    shp=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for col,cells in os_: shp[_key(cells)].append((col,cells))
    grps=[v for v in shp.values() if len(v)>1]
    occ=collections.Counter(c for c,_ in os_)
    dupcols=set(c for gp in grps for c,_ in gp)
    tcands=[]
    for c_ in occ:
        if occ[c_]!=1 or c_ in dupcols: continue
        cl=[x for cc,x in os_ if cc==c_][0]
        if len(shp[_key(cl)])==1: tcands.append((c_,len(cl)))
    tcol=max(tcands,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    T=[cl for c2,cl in os_ if c2==tcol][0]
    pures=[gp for gp in grps if len(set(c for c,_ in gp))==1]
    pool = pures if pures else grps
    sel=max(pool,key=lambda gp:max(len(cl) for _,cl in gp))
    m=max(sel,key=lambda m:(_mindist(m[1],T),max(r for r,_ in m[1])))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for a,b in m[1]: out[a][b]=tcol
    return out
